result: Overview pictures render before tiles; every part uses the item's optional display range.
decisions: Keep first accepted one-band overview validMin/validMax in the plan header; never rescan source pixels.
Invert LAS header Z scale/offset and round to raw record integers, matching the browser's native Z records.
Legacy headers remain untouched; absent ranges retain per-part greys and the existing Z-rank colours.
Studio locally extends the generated display type; integration owns OpenAPI and api-client regeneration.

acceptance: Overview order stays below tiles when arriving last or replaced; part 0 is under before later parts arrive.
Different raster ranges produce equal grey for equal values on the shared range; outliers clamp.
Different point ranks produce equal colours for equal raw Z on the shared range; outliers clamp.
Fallback shading is unchanged; masks, no-data and all-no-data parts stay transparent.
Every point display returns the first header range or omits it; display reads leave parts/hashes untouched.
Only one-band rasters with both extrema keep a range; later accepted parts cannot replace it.
